key_concepts: Pressed solid materials may change size and shape
Pressed solid materials may change texture
Pressing changes only physical appearance and forms no new material
Hammered solid materials may change size and shape
Hammered solid materials may change texture
A hammer is a hand tool with a solid head used for beating or pounding materials
Solid materials have properties such as size, shape, color, and texture
Bending, pressing, hammering, and cutting change only physical appearance, not the materia
